title: Simulation code and data for: Toward Clinical Resilience of Remote Patient Monitoring over UAV-Assisted LEO Backhaul under Coverage Gaps, Jamming and Denial of Service
description: ns-3 (system-level) and ns-3 + 5G-LENA (full 5G NR) scenarios, run scripts, Python analysis pipeline and per-run result summaries for a study of IoMT clinical QoS resilience (emergency alarms, ECG, store-and-forward records) over a UAV-assisted bent-pipe LEO backhaul under coverage gaps, jamming and denial of service. Targets follow 3GPP TR 22.826 cardiac telemetry; energy follows 3GPP TR 45.820 and TR 38.840.
